pick.title: Generative AI Policies Across 120 University Syllabi
pick.abstract: We coded the generative AI policies of 120 syllabi from 14 universities. 41% banned AI outright, 37% allowed it with disclosure and 22% required it for at least one assignment. Courses that required AI also more often redesigned assessment around in-class work.
pick.why: What university instructors actually allow, ban or require in their AI policies.
pick.summary: Of 120 syllabi, 41% banned generative AI, 37% allowed it with disclosure and 22% required it.
